query: UPDATE central.recovery_epoch_workspaces AS work SET delivery_state = 'failed', claim_token_hash = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, retry_not_before = NULL, failure_class = $4, failure_reason = $5, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE work.epoch_generation = $1 AND work.workspace_id = $2 AND work.delivery_state = 'claimed' AND work.claim_token_hash = $3 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM central.recovery_epochs epoch WHERE epoch.epoch_generation = work.epoch_generation AND epoch.coordinator_domain = $6)
